name: IRC_ACCESS_TOKENS
description: This table contains Access Codes for external candidates accessing their information.

columns.name: ACCESS_TOKEN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the token or access code. System generated value.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFIRMED_FLAG
columns.description: The flag field that identifies if the access code is for a confirmed candidate.

columns.name: ACCESS_CODE
columns.description: Access code to validate that candidate owns e-mail address.

columns.name: ACCESS_CODE_EXP_DATE
columns.description: Expiration date and time for the access code

columns.name: TOKEN
columns.description: Encrypted verification token, stored to log that it has been used.

columns.name: TOKEN_EXP_DATE
columns.description: Expiration date extracted from the token

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Candidate's email address for whom the access code was generated.

columns.name: PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Candidate's phone number for whom the Access Code was generated.

columns.name: PROPOSED_CAND_NUM
columns.description: Proposed number to be used for the new candidate.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the candidate to whom Access Code refers.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_COUNT
columns.description: Counts the number of submissions made with the access code.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRACKING_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the source tracking information related to the Access Code.

columns.name: URL_SHORT_CODE
columns.description: Short representation of the URL fragment found in TARGET column.

columns.name: URL_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date and time of validity for the URL.

columns.name: SIGNIN_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date and time of validity for the login attempt.

columns.name: URL_EXP_DATE
columns.description: End date and time of validity for the URL.

columns.name: TARGET
columns.description: Full URL fragment represented by the URL_SHORT_CODE.

columns.name: CONSUMER_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: Name and value pairs needed by the consumer of the Short URL.

columns.name: CHALLENGE_REQUIRED
columns.description: Indicates what kind of challenge will be required for visitor to the URL.

columns.name: CONSUMER
columns.description: Indicates which Consumer feature is using this URL.

columns.name: SHORT_CODE
columns.description: The Short Code sent to the candidate for further verification.

columns.name: SHORT_CODE_EXP_DATE
columns.description: Expiration date and time for the Short Code.

columns.name: FAILED_VALIDATION_COUNT
columns.description: Counts the number of failed attempts at verifying the Short Code

columns.name: FAILED_SIGNIN_COUNT
columns.description: Counts the number of failed attempts to login.

columns.name: DEVICE
columns.description: An identifier for the browser associated to the row.

columns.name: PERSISTENT_ACCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the row can be used to provide recurring access.

columns.name: LAST_ACCESS_REAUTH_DATE
columns.description: The last date the user authenticated to the system for persisted access.

columns.name: LAST_ACCESS_REFRESH_DATE
columns.description: The last date the user renewed their access to the system for persisted access.

columns.name: PHONE_CHANNEL_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates if the phone login uses WhatsApp or another communication channel

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
